name: io.github.blink1217/quant-swarm
title: quant-swarm
description: Free offline backtest forensics (lookahead bias, Newey-West + BH t-stats, cost survival) and hosted Point-in-Time SEC/macro data.

environmentVariables.name: SWARM_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional token from https://1.21initiative.com/mcp/ for hosted Point-in-Time (pit.*, market.*_pit) tools. Local backtest forensics (audit.backtest, warden.*, gym.*) run 100% offline for free with no token.

packageArguments.description: Launch unified quant-swarm MCP server (12 core tools by default; pass --profile warden|data|gym|full for specialist suites)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token from https://1.21initiative.com/mcp/> (metadata discovery is public; token required on tools/call).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token from https://1.21initiative.com/mcp/>. Hosted gym compute is metered in credits (1 per simulated episode).
